info.title: ShopperStop rider API
info.description: The rider service: the riders who deliver orders, their sign-in and sessions, and the staff routes that manage them. Every error is the envelope {"error": {code, message, field?}}. Routes that need a signed-in rider or staff user take Authorization: Bearer <token>: a rider's token from sign-in, or a staff token that core issued and this service checks with core.

tags.name: rider-service
tags.description: Rider sign-in, sessions and the signed-in rider.

tags.name: deliveries
tags.description: Ready orders, claims, deliveries, rider location and the customer's view of a delivery.

tags.name: dispatch
tags.description: Offers of ready orders to online riders: the rider's open offer, accept and decline, and the staff view of an order's dispatch.

get.description: Answers 200 whenever the process is up. Does not touch the database.
Answers 200 when the database answers a ping within 2 seconds. Answers 503 with code internal otherwise.

503.description: The database did not answer within 2 seconds.

post.description: Checks the email and password and answers a new session token. The rider's other sessions stay signed in. A wrong password, an unknown email and an inactive rider all answer the same 401. More than 10 attempts for one email, or more than 100 from one client IP, within an hour answer 429.

200.description: The new session and the rider.

400.description: The email is not an address, or the password is empty.

error.message: must be a valid email address

401.description: Wrong email or password, or the rider is inactive.

429.description: Too many sign-in attempts for this email or client IP within an hour.

error.message: too many attempts, try again later

post.description: Ends the session of the bearer token. The rider's other sessions stay signed in.

401.description: No token, or a token that is not a live session of an active rider.

get.description: Answers the rider the bearer token belongs to.

401.description: No token, or a token that is not a live session of an active rider.

put.description: Sets the signed-in rider online (offered orders by the dispatcher) or offline (the default). Going online keeps the time the rider first went online while they stay online. Going offline waits for a running dispatcher tick, then sets the rider offline and expires their open offer in one transaction. Signing out and staff deactivation also take the rider offline.

200.description: The rider with the new isOnline.

400.description: online missing or null (field online), or not a boolean (no field).

401.description: No bearer, or a token that is not a live session of an active rider.

get.description: One page of riders ordered by email. An admin sees every store's riders, or one store's with store. Store staff see their own store's riders; a store parameter naming another store is 403 forbidden. A store that is not a uuid is 400 on store. The staff token is checked with core, and the answer is cached for 30 seconds per token.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Riders per page, from 1 to 100. Default 24.

parameters.name: store
parameters.description: Only riders of this store (core's store id). Admins may name any store; store staff may name only their own, or get 403.

400.description: page or pageSize is out of range, or store is not a uuid.

401.description: No token, or core does not know the token as a staff user.

error.message: store staff list their own store only

502.description: Core failed to answer the staff check (a 500, a timeout or no connection).

post.description: Creates an active rider at a store core knows, and answers it. Email, name (1 to 100 characters), phone (optional: empty, or 10 to 15 digits after an optional +) and password (8 to 72 bytes) are checked as core checks a customer's. Store staff may create riders only at their own store. A store core does not know is 400 on storeId; an email taken in any case is 409 on email.

400.description: A field is malformed, or core does not know the store (then field is storeId).

401.description: No token, or core does not know the token as a staff user.

error.message: store staff create riders at their own store only

409.description: The email is already a rider's, in any case.

502.description: Core failed to answer the staff check (a 500, a timeout or no connection).

get.description: Answers the rider in the path. Store staff get 404 for a rider of another store, as for an id that does not exist.

401.description: No token, or core does not know the token as a staff user.

404.description: No rider with this id at a store the caller may see.

502.description: Core failed to answer the staff check (a 500, a timeout or no connection).

patch.description: Changes name, phone ("" clears it), isActive and password; absent members stay as they are, and null is refused with 400 on the member. storeId and email cannot change. Setting isActive to false ends the rider's sessions in the same change, so the rider's token answers 401 and the rider cannot sign in. A new password does not end sessions.

400.description: A member is null or malformed.

401.description: No token, or core does not know the token as a staff user.

404.description: No rider with this id at a store the caller may see.

502.description: Core failed to answer the staff check (a 500, a timeout or no connection).

get.summary: Ready orders of the rider's store
get.description: Answers the orders core holds as ready at the signed-in rider's store that no delivery holds, oldest placed first. Orders of other stores never appear. The answer is one core page of 100 orders, a working set rather than a browsable list.

200.description: The ready orders of the rider's store.

401.description: No token, or a token that is not a live session of an active rider.

502.description: Core failed to answer (a 500, a timeout, no connection, or core refused the service token).

get.description: Answers the signed-in rider's deliveries in one status, newest claim first: assigned by default, or delivered. Another rider's deliveries never appear. A status other than assigned or delivered is 400 on status.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Deliveries per page, from 1 to 100. Default 24.

200.description: One page of the rider's deliveries in the status.

400.description: page or pageSize is out of range, or status is not assigned or delivered.

401.description: No token, or a token that is not a live session of an active rider.

post.description: Gives the signed-in rider a ready order of their store. The order's details are copied into a new delivery with status assigned, and core moves the order to out_for_delivery with the rider as actor. The delivery and the move happen in one transaction: when core refuses or fails, no delivery is left behind. An order that already has a delivery is 409 "order already claimed"; an order core holds in another status is 409 "order is not ready for pickup". An unknown order and another store's order are 404, and core is not asked to move them.

400.description: The orderId is not a uuid.

401.description: No token, or a token that is not a live session of an active rider.

404.description: No order with this id, or the order is another store's.

409.description: The order already has a delivery, or core does not hold it as ready.

error.message: order is not ready for pickup

502.description: Core failed to answer or to move the order (a 500, a timeout, no connection, or core refused the service token).

get.description: Answers one delivery of the signed-in rider. Another rider's delivery, an unknown id and an id that is not a uuid are all 404.

401.description: No token, or a token that is not a live session of an active rider.

404.description: No delivery with this id, or it is another rider's, or the id is not a uuid.

post.description: Moves the order to delivered in core with the signed-in rider as actor, then stamps the delivery with deliveredAt and answers it. The two steps share one transaction: when core refuses or fails, the delivery stays assigned and core's answer passes through (409, 404 or 502). A delivery that is already delivered is 409 "delivery is not assigned".

200.description: The delivery, status delivered with deliveredAt.

401.description: No token, or a token that is not a live session of an active rider.

404.description: No delivery with this id, or it is another rider's, or the id is not a uuid.

409.description: The delivery is not assigned, or core refused the move (the order is not out for delivery).

502.description: Core failed to answer or to move the order (a 500, a timeout, no connection, or core refused the service token).

put.description: Stores the signed-in rider's last position, replacing the previous one, stamped with the server's clock. Accepted whether or not the rider has an assigned delivery. lat is checked before lng; a missing or out-of-range value is 400 naming the field, and nothing is stored.

204.description: The position was stored. No body.

400.description: A missing lat or lng, lat outside -90 to 90, or lng outside -180 to 180. Nothing is stored.

401.description: No bearer, or a token that is not a live session of an active rider.

get.summary: A customer's view of their order's delivery
get.description: Reads the order from core with the customer's bearer, which proves the order is theirs, then answers the rider's name and the delivery's status. location appears only while the delivery is assigned and the rider reported a position after the claim. The rider's phone, email and id are never shown. Another customer's order and an order without a delivery are 404; a bearer core does not know is 401.

200.description: The delivery as the customer sees it.

401.description: No bearer, or a bearer core does not know.

404.description: Another customer's order, an order with no delivery, or an id that is not a uuid.

502.description: Core failed to answer (a 500, a timeout, no connection, or core refused the service token).

get.description: Answers the signed-in rider's open offer, polled by the rider app while online. An offer past its expiry, or whose order another rider claimed by hand, counts as none before the dispatcher marks it.

204.description: The rider has no open offer. No body.

401.description: No bearer, or a token that is not a live session of an active rider.

post.description: Accepts the rider's open offer: one transaction marks it accepted and claims the order as POST /me/deliveries does (the delivery, then core's out_for_delivery with the rider as actor). When another rider already claimed the order, or core no longer holds it as ready, the offer is expired and the answer is 409. When core fails the offer stays open.

401.description: No bearer, or a token that is not a live session of an active rider.

404.description: Not the rider's offer, an unknown id, or an id that is not a uuid.

409.description: The offer was already answered or expired (offer is no longer open), or the order went to another rider or left ready (order is no longer available).

502.description: Core failed or could not be reached; the offer stays open.

post.description: Declines the rider's open offer. The dispatcher offers the order to the next rider and does not offer it to this rider again for 2 minutes.

401.description: No bearer, or a token that is not a live session of an active rider.

404.description: Not the rider's offer, an unknown id, or an id that is not a uuid.

409.description: The offer was already answered or expired.

get.description: For staff (a core staff token): reads the order from core with the rider's service token, then answers the store's online rider count, whether dispatch is on, and the order's latest offers. Store staff read only their own store's orders; another store's order is 404, as an unknown one is.

401.description: No bearer, or a token core does not answer as staff.

404.description: Core does not know the order, it is another store's order (store staff), or the id is not a uuid.

502.description: Core failed or could not be reached.

bearer.description: A rider's token from sign-in, or a staff token from core, sent as Authorization: Bearer <token>.

storeId.description: The store the rider works at (core's store id).

phone.description: Omitted when the rider has no phone.

isOnline.description: true while the rider is online for dispatch offers (PUT /me/availability).

token.description: Send as Authorization: Bearer <token>. Shown once.

phone.description: Optional. Empty, or 10 to 15 digits after an optional +.

RiderPatch.description: Every member is optional; null is refused.

total.description: Every rider the caller may see, not just this page.

number.description: The order number the customer and the store see.

itemCount.description: Units carried: the sum of the line quantities.

paymentMethod.description: Core's payment method: cod is cash on delivery, the rider collects the total; online is paid through the payment service.

paymentStatus.description: Online orders only, omitted for cash: core's payment status, read live.

line2.description: Omitted when the order has none.

storeId.description: The store the order belongs to (core's store id).

customerPhone.description: Omitted when the order has none.

paymentMethod.description: Core's payment method at the claim: cod is cash on delivery, the rider collects the total; online is paid through the payment service.

paymentStatus.description: Online orders only, omitted for cash: core's payment status at the claim. Core freezes it from ready on (a paid order cannot be cancelled once packing), so it stays paid.

itemCount.description: Units carried: the sum of the line quantities.

deliveredAt.description: Omitted until the delivery is delivered.

total.description: Every delivery of the caller in this status, not just this page.

recordedAt.description: When the server received the position.

location.description: The rider's last position, only while the delivery is assigned and recorded after the claim. Omitted otherwise.

online.description: true to go online for dispatch offers, false to go offline.

Offer.description: The dispatcher's offer of one ready order to one rider, with the order as core showed it when the offer was made.

placedAt.description: When the customer placed the order.

itemCount.description: Units to carry: the sum of the line quantities.

paymentStatus.description: Online orders only, as core held it when the offer was made.

etaSeconds.description: The rider's straight-line time to the store when the offer was made; 0 within 100 m.

offeredAt.description: When the dispatcher made the offer.

expiresAt.description: After this the offer can no longer be accepted; the dispatcher then offers the order to the next rider.

DispatchOffer.description: One offer of an order, as staff see it.

etaSeconds.description: The rider's straight-line time to the store when the offer was made.

offeredAt.description: When the dispatcher made the offer.

answeredAt.description: When the offer was accepted, declined or expired; omitted while it is open.

OrderDispatch.description: An order's dispatch: the store's online riders, whether the dispatcher runs for the store, and the order's latest offers.

online.description: Riders of the order's store who are online now.

dispatch.description: off while the dispatcher is turned off (SHOPPERSTOP_RIDER_DISPATCH_INTERVAL=0) or the store has no location in core.

offers.description: The order's latest 10 offers, newest first; empty when it has none.
